text:
QUOTE: "`skipSync: true` | add path, `websocket/reactions.ts:28` | `sanitizeReactions` returns `deleteReactions: []`. Without it, `deleteReactions` would be every stored reaction on the post not in the one-element list, so a single `reaction_added` would delete all other users' reactions."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that without skipSync the single incoming reaction would be treated as the full list, and all other reactions on the post would be deleted.
